assessor: Schemaxis implementation assessment reconciled with independent whole-inventory review and integrated acceptance

scope.denominator: Compression controls, compatibility codecs, streaming and frames, dictionaries, reference deltas, inspection and performance selection.

coverage.rationale: Twelve typed tasks cover the reviewed bounded stable CLI inventory, including all five codecs, finite streaming and frames, advanced matching/scheduling/adaptive controls, trained/raw dictionaries, deltas, benchmarks and recursive/named file sets. Source-bound native, full host/Studio and clean installed-product acceptance pass. The existing conservative editorial score is retained; it is not an API ratio or acceptance gate.

scope.description: Captured content, reusable dictionaries, earlier snapshots and checked compressed streams.
scope.denominator: Intent and meaningful choices in declared durable workflows.

abstraction.rationale: Task-level intents hide CLI process and provenance boilerplate while expert compression overrides remain available.

limitations: Accepted stable CLI content scope, with documented resource caps; library ABI/application embedding and unbounded persistent pipe service are separate product boundaries. No public release is claimed.
Adaptive content and frame policy are verified, but the historical native level schedule cannot be reconstructed.
Recorded profile wall time is observational; later verification proves content and size, not historical timing.
File sets retain relative names and bytes; filesystem permissions, ownership and timestamps are not archived.
